title: Restrained (status group)
html:
This article is about the group of conditions. For the specific condition, see Restrained (Condition).

SG_Restrained is a status group. This group encompasses conditions which physically impair a creature's movement.

Removal

The following spells/actions remove all conditions in this status group:

  • Help
  • Unshackling Strike

The following conditions remove all conditions in this status group:

  •  Inevitable Resolve

Immunity

The following items grant immunity to all conditions in this status group:

  • Elixir of Guileful Movement
  • Ring of Free Action

The following spells/actions grant immunity to all conditions in this status group:

  • Freedom of Movement

The following passive features grant immunity to all conditions in this status group:

  •  Nature's Step

The following conditions grant immunity to all conditions in this status group:

  •  Absorbed Essence: Illasera
  •  Weavewalker

Advantage and Disadvantage

The following items grant  Advantage on saving throws to all conditions in this status group:

  • The Mighty Cloth

List of conditions in SG_Restrained

Condition Effects
Black Tentacles
  • Restrained by dark tendrils. Affected entity can't move and takes 3d6⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage per turn.
  • Attack Rolls against the affected entity have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws have  Disadvantage
Chains of Karsus
  • The Netherbrain is too powerful for even the Momentary God's magic - Karsus' Compulsion could not dominate it completely.
  • The spell has instead bound the brain's will in place temporarily. To complete the domination, you must strike it down.
Constricted
  • Affected entity can't move.  Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, while its attack rolls and Dexterity  Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.
  • The entity takes 2d6+2⁠⁠Piercing and 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic per turn.
  • Can be removed by  Help.
Ensnared
  • Cannot move and takes 1d6⁠⁠Piercing damage per turn.
  •  Attack Rolls against the creature have  Advantage, while the creature's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.
  • Remove when  Helped.

  • ⁠Slashing and ⁠Fire damage remove the netting.

  • Cannot move.

  • Cannot move.
  •  Attack Rolls against the creature have  Advantage, while the creature's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving Throws are rolled with  Disadvantage.
Flesh to Stone: Restrained Stage 1
  • Affected entity cannot move as its body begins to petrify over the course of 3 turns.
  •  Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.
Flesh to Stone: Restrained Stage 2
  • Affected entity cannot move as its body progresses toward petrification.
  •  Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.
Flesh to Stone: Restrained Stage 3
  • Affected entity cannot move as its body enters the final bone-stiffening stages of petrification.
  •  Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.
Garrotted
  • Affected entity is being strangled by a garrotte. It is Silenced and takes 3d6⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage per turn.
  • Both the entity and the garrotter can't move until the condition ends.
  • If the entity and the garrotter are forcibly moved more than 5 m (17 ft) apart, this condition ends.
Garrotted: Restrained
  • Cannot move.  Attack Rolls against the affected entity have  Advantage, while the entity's  Attack Rolls and  Dexterity Saving Throws have  Disadvantage
Hamstrung
  • Movement Speed reduced by 50%.
  • Removed by healing.
Muddy
  • Affect entity is covered in hardened mud and its Movement Speed is halved.
  • Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.
  • Immune to  Burning and Wild Magic: Burning.
  • Resistant to ⁠Fire damage.
Nature's Wrath
  • Cannot move.
  • Attack Rolls against the affected creature have  Advantage.
  • The creature's Attack Rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.
Pinned Down
  • Movement Speed is reduced by 3 m (10 ft).

Shadow-Cursed Vines
  • Affected entity can't move and takes 1d4⁠⁠NecroticDRS damage per turn. Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, while its Attack Rolls and Dexterity  Saving Throws have  Disadvantage.
Weavebound Vines
  • Vines crafted from the very Weave itself - a most unorthodox enchantment.
  • Incapacitates the affected entity. Dispelled when the entity is attacked.
